<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 193.079 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few millidaltons and yields an integer double‑bond equivalent is C₁₀H₁₁NO₃ (DBE = 6). Therefore the molecular formula in the required format is C10H11O3N.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H11O3N</final_answer>
